notes.title: Update 22-03-24
notes.notes: Fixed an issue (hopefully) where the player's character sometimes wouldn't pick up a pistol during the tutorial, making the game unplayable.

notes.title: Update 22-01-29
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue that enemies' hand twitches occasionally when running.
 Minor typo correction (applies to Korean version only)

notes.title: Update 22-01-16
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed bugs related to event dialog.
 Fixed UI related bugs.
 Fixed bugs in the tutorial.
 Fixed reload bug in bullet counter mod.

notes.title: Hotfix #2 22-01-15
notes.notes:
Bug Fix

Fixed an issue that could sometimes cause the player's character to get stuck in the fence that appears after the shopping street section, preventing the game from progressing any further.

notes.title: Hotfix 22-01-15
notes.notes:
This is the first hotfix for Reloader: test_subject!


Miscellaneous

 Changed the dialogue sound effect.
 Changed the position of the buttons for the option menu.


Bug Fix

Completing a stage with a pistol with the magazine removed will no longer generate a new magazine for the next stage.
